raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart’s father by misreading the Wikipedia snippet. The snippet clearly states his father was John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart (eldest son of the 1st Marquess of Bute), but the Planner concluded the father was John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute. This led to searching the wrong person’s death date and producing the incorrect final answer (1814 instead of the father’s actual death in 1794).
